lessonRef.unitTitle: PF7 — Paying Taxes and Financial Plan Capstone
lessonRef.title: Performance task build: tax forms and withholding concepts

objective: Learners compute invented withholding across a year, compare it with a liability, and evaluate the size of the resulting refund.
scenario: Rhiannon is a made-up eighth grader modelling a pretend year: $3,800.00 monthly gross with 14% withheld, against an invented annual liability of $5,900.00. All figures are invented.
safetyNotes: Every amount, person, business, and account in this task is invented for practice. Nothing here refers to a real household.
Never write a real bank account, card, PIN, password, Social Security, or tax number on this sheet; the task never asks for one.
This is education, not individualized financial advice. Real money decisions belong to a trusted adult.

tasks.directions: Compute Rhiannon's invented monthly withholding at 14% of $3,800.00.

prompts.text: How much is withheld each month?

tasks.directions: Project Rhiannon's withholding across the year and compare it with the $5,900.00 liability.

prompts.text: What is withheld across the year?

tasks.directions: Work out what monthly withholding would have matched the liability exactly, and how much extra was withheld each month.

prompts.text: What monthly withholding would have matched the liability?
How much extra was withheld each month?

tasks.directions: The refund arrived as a lump, having left as small monthly amounts.

prompts.text: Argue whether Rhiannon should adjust her withholding, weighing the value of $40.33 a month against the discipline of a lump-sum refund.

remediation: If a learner computes the refund before the annual withholding, require Rhiannon's annual total to be written and boxed before any comparison.
extension: Ask the learner what withholding percentage would match Rhiannon's liability most closely, and to show the method.
